journey.name: Discover — trending tags, add friend, follow
journey.description: Social discovery: trending tag chips from the Nexus staging indexer, add a friend by pubky, follow them, and open one of their decks (foreign-deck remote load). Requires a signed-in session (journey 01). The friend pubky used below must exist on staging and have at least one published Loopky deck — substitute a known staging pubky before running, or accept the follow/profile steps as the verification target.

actions.action: Launch the Loopky app and verify the Home screen is shown
Tap the element with resource-id "tab_discover" in the bottom tab bar
Verify the Discover screen is shown with an "Add friend" button (resource-id: discover_add_friend)

Verify a bottom sheet appears with a "Paste a pubky" input (resource-id: add_friend_input), a "Scan QR" button (resource-id: add_friend_scan) and an "Open" button (resource-id: add_friend_open) — these ids only surface because the sheet sets its own testTagsAsResourceId
Type your OWN pubky into the field with resource-id "add_friend_input" and tap the element with resource-id "add_friend_open"
Verify your own profile is shown with NO Follow button (regression: you could follow yourself)
Navigate back to Discover and tap the element with resource-id "discover_add_friend" again
If a "Trending on Pubky" section with tag chips is visible, tap the first trending tag chip and verify the deck list filters (decks with the tag, or a "No decks tagged" empty state)
If a tag chip is selected, tap it again to clear the filter
